answer: Give every agent one durable identity anchored by a refundable bond: before an agent can earn, it locks a jade-grade deposit that only unlocks after a long season of honest work. Peers watch for clones the way desert travellers read a dune — a single honest trail is cheap to verify, but a swarm of fresh identities marching in lockstep leaves a pattern no honest newcomer makes. When two identities are proven to be the same operator, both bonds are cut and the quartz-clear record is published, so the next swarm must pay full price again. Forgery stays possible, but never profitable.
